featured_reviews.name: Ruman D
featured_reviews.review_text:
Fantastic fast charging experience. Charged a Tata Punch EV from 51-100% in 57 mins. GreenShift app has a simple and effective UI — I absolutely dread charging an EV but this was a breeze. Went from downloading app to charging in less than 2 mins. Zero wait time (helped that it was a Sunday afternoon). There are four guns in total + I think a smaller charger for low-capacity cars/scooters. Charger/parking layout may only allow for two cars to be charged alongside.

Easy accessibility from Thane-Belapur road. Advisable to stock up on water/snacks from nearby (<200m) stores.

Unit charge: Rs 16 per kWh.
Units consumed: 20.65 kWh
Charging fee: 330.38 + taxes
Total: 389.85

featured_reviews.name: S Pai
featured_reviews.review_text: Easy to find on the main road. Extremely polluted place so avoid if you can. Charging speed is capped at 30 kW even if one one gun is active. Regularly used by commercial cab fleet

featured_reviews.name: Sandeep Atluri
featured_reviews.review_text: Very friendly and courteous staff.
